Cebuano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish nido (“nest”), from Latin nīdus.

Noun

[edit]

nido (Badlit spelling ᜈᜒᜇᜓ)

  1. edible bird's nest made into nido soup in Chinese-Filipino cuisine

Finnish

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

nido

  1. inflection of nitoa:
    1. present active indicative connegative
    2. second-person singular present imperative
    3. second-person singular present active imperative connegative

Anagrams

[edit]
  • dino

Italian

[edit]
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
nido
Wikipedia it

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • nidio

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin nīdus, from Proto-Italic *nizdos (“nest”), from Proto-Indo-European *nisdós (“nest”). Compare French nid, Spanish nido, Portuguese ninho.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈni.do/
  • Rhymes: -ido
  • Hyphenation: nì‧do
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

nido m (plural nidi)

  1. nest
  2. (figurative) home
  3. nursery school, preschool
    Synonyms: asilo, scuola dell'infanzia

Spanish nido

    Inherited from Old Spanish nido, from Latin nīdus.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈnido/ [ˈni.ð̞o]
    • Audio (Colombia):(file)
    • Rhymes: -ido
    • Syllabification: ni‧do

    Noun

    [edit]

    nido m (plural nidos)

    1. nest
    2. (Philippines) edible bird's nest (commonly found in El Nido, Palawan and usually made into nido soup in Chinese restaurants)

    Tagalog

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

    Borrowed from Spanish nido (“nest”), from Latin nīdus. See also El Nido (literally “The Nest”) in Palawan, where the edible bird's nest is historically harvested from by a busyador.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ˈnido/ [ˈn̪iː.d̪o]
    • Rhymes: -ido
    • Syllabification: ni‧do

    Noun

    [edit]

    nido (Baybayin spelling ᜈᜒᜇᜓ)

    1. edible bird's nest (commonly found in El Nido, Palawan and usually made into nido soup in Chinese restaurants)

    Further reading

    [edit]
    • “nido”, in KWF Diksiyonaryo ng Wikang Filipino, Komisyon sa Wikang Filipino, 2025
    • “nido”, in Pambansang Diksiyonaryo | Diksiyonaryo.ph, 2018
